chapter_title: The Man Who Didn't Look Right
narration_script: The process of behavior change always starts with awareness. You cannot change a habit you do not know exists. This is the Habits Scorecard exercise. Write down your daily habits. Then mark each as good, bad, or neutral. Good habits align with your desired identity. Bad habits oppose it. The simple act of writing down your behaviors forces you to notice what you actually do each day. Without judgment. Just observation. Once you are aware of your habits you can begin to improve them. The first law of behavior change is make it obvious. And the first step is awareness.
